competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.description: Bet365 competition identifiers (e.g. 'epl', 'laliga', 'serie-a'). If empty, scrapes all top competitions discovered from the football directory.

maxFixtures.title: Max fixtures
maxFixtures.description: Hard cap on the number of fixtures to scrape per run. 0 means no cap.

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Apify proxy. Residential is strongly recommended for Bet365.

geoCountry.title: Geo country (ISO-3166 alpha-2)
geoCountry.description: Two-letter country code controlling Bet365 regional site (e.g. 'GB', 'ES', 'DE', 'AU'). Determines the TLD ('com', 'es', 'de', 'com.au') and which regional WS host the actor connects to.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enable verbose logging including raw protocol frames.
